about.intro: Hi! I'm a web developer who builds modern, fast, and user-friendly web applications. I value clean code, thoughtful architecture, and attention to detail. I'm constantly learning new technologies and strive to create solutions that are both reliable and enjoyable to use.

experience.creosLanding: Developed the frontend for a landing page promoting one of the company's services
experience.creosPlatform: Contributed to a video creative production management platform. Clients create and manage orders, review deliverables, and provide feedback. Implemented role-based access for clients, designers, and managers. Clients can generate AI-assisted creative concepts and previews. Designers manage assigned tasks, track progress, and handle financial workflows. Managers assign work, monitor project progress, manage team workloads, and administer the platform.
experience.creosAnalytics: Developed an internal analytics portal with dashboards for subcontractor performance, profitability, project statistics, and designer workload, revenue, completed projects, and performance indicators.
experience.architectureDesign: Design of buildings, interiors, structures, and small architectural forms
experience.textAnalysis: Analyzed text data and media content
experience.googleProject: Short-term project collecting, processing, and analyzing information about local organizations and businesses
